title: Show the lifecycle on the badge instead of the coarse status
outcome: A reader sees the stage a Change is actually in. The second badge, and the condition that decided whether to show it, are gone.
acceptanceCriteria: ChangeCard and ChangeOverview take lifecycle and render one badge from it; the status prop and the lifecycle-differs-from-status condition are removed from both.
The badge colour still follows the derived coarse status, so an archived Change keeps its primary tint and an in-progress one its warning tint; only the label changes.
A Change in pre-pr-review is labelled pre-pr-review rather than In Progress, covered by a component test.
The design-system component showcase is updated to the new props and still renders.
